_meta.source: RAGTruth validation split, 100 records per task (50 hallucinated / 50 supported), model longformer-head, measured with verify_app_inference.py
_meta.caveat: Rates come from a 50/50 balanced sample and ~100 records per task, so they are rough. Real-world precision depends on how often your RAG system hallucinates.

QA.note: Validation: scores >= 0.60 flagged 34% of hallucinations and 2% of supported answers. Scores below 0.30 still contained 38% of hallucinations.

Summarization.note: Validation AUC was 0.50 (chance): supported and hallucinated summaries received the same average score (0.31 vs 0.32). No threshold separates them.

Data-to-text.note: Validation: scores >= 0.70 flagged 82% of hallucinations and 18% of supported answers. Scores below 0.40 still contained 16% of hallucinations. This task is mostly hallucinated in the data (about 64-69%), so scores run high.
